definitions.explanation: Describes the color yellow. This is one of the most common color adjectives in Japanese. Unlike many colors that are na-adjectives, きいろい is an i-adjective.

examples.japanese: {黄色|きいろ}い⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{咲|さ}いています→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黄色|きいろ}く⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{黄色|きいろ}い⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{黄色|きいろ}い⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{見|み}つけやすい→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Yellow taxis stand out, so they're easy to find.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄色|きいろ}く⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{きれい|きれい}→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow and are very beautiful.

notes: きいろい is one of the basic color terms in Japanese. The noun form is {黄色|きいろ} (kiiro). Unlike many color words that are na-adjectives (like {緑|みどり}), きいろい is an i-adjective. Yellow is associated with caution in Japan, similar to Western cultures (yellow traffic lights, warning signs).
